purpose: Add a safe API to compare the same candidate EOG transition rules before/after positive observation filtering without incorrectly applying fixed-source world-set monotonicity to self-excluded peer-source compatibility.

data_and_model_scope.source_context: Prior Draft PR #697 authentic wetland date×method gate shows real recorded positive witness loss, but supplies NO calibrated graph/source nodes. The new API's tests use only synthetic directed A/B/C rules, not ecological field world evidence.
data_and_model_scope.frozen_operator_input: One shared Mapping[str, DynamicTransitionOperator] passed once to both calls; threshold/max_steps/sources also single arguments so contract cannot drift between runs.
data_and_model_scope.filter_contract: full and filtered must have >=2 unique observed nodes; filtered proper subset of full; retained fixed declared sources cannot be dropped; same node universe.
data_and_model_scope.output: Dataclass with full/filtered compatible rule IDs, shared/lost/gained identity sets, frozen fingerprints, per-retained-target changed peer source IDs and support, explicit fixed-source monotonicity guard, data universe certificate.
data_and_model_scope.compatibility_invariants: Under fixed source, lost compatible rules when removing positive observation must be zero; self excluded may gain and lose rules and must never claim monotonicity or use EOG fixed-world compare_reconstructions.
data_and_model_scope.regression: No existing dataclass signature/result payload/fingerprint altered; new API is opt-in, exported via EOG traversability facade.

frozen_synthetic_test.all_64_test: all 64 directed simple three-node edge masks, fixed source A and self excluded, loss support=1, first-passage max_steps=1

scientific_limits: This is a prospective software safety guard, not a causal, occupancy or biological model, and adds no EOG-WF endpoint.
Detected/nondetected species in any field survey are not equated to true absence.
The native EOG candidate rule universe is not a calibrated universe of true ecological worlds.
The API reports evidence-dependent peer-source membership without inventing a probabilistic likelihood or monotonicity guarantee.
Changes do not modify the frozen Draft PR #697 or its 3 scored/31 scientific STOP/3 administrative exclusions.
